messages:
deploybot: ALERT: prod-canary p95 spike detected at 2026-12-01T02:12:14Z. Auto-rollback suppressed by release pin. Hotfix image ready: redwood/inference:2026-12-01-hf-kvfix. Requesting expedited unpin + 15m change window. @rachel @punit please ack.

rachel: on it. paste the failing snippet?

deploybot: probe: /generate p95=740ms (baseline 180ms). log: `WARN runtime.kv-cache: eviction storm -> miss spike`

punit: likely the recent kv-ttl flag flip. hotfix reverts flag and raises soft-threshold. validated in staging (smoke x4).

emma: infra check: nodes healthy, transient CPU at deploy time, no IO issues. no other rolling jobs.

rachel: require PM note and a pinned image. emma, can you confirm customer notification?

emma: will update changelog and ping dedicated contacts once canary stable. image pinned in notes.

punit: roll plan: lift pin -> canary 5% for 8m -> ramp to 100% if p95 <= baseline*1.25 and errors < 0.5%. rollback if thresholds breached.

rachel: deploybot queue with guard rails: freeze new deploys and audit tag.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy --image redwood/inference:2026-12-01-hf-kvfix --scope canary --ramp 5% --observe 480s --auto-rollback "p95>+25% || errors>0.5%" --override-pin release-lead-rachel --freeze-new-deploys --audit "unpin-kv-1201"`

ops-oncall: infra +1, freezing new deploys now.

rachel: +approve (release lead, expedite). punit?

punit: +eng.

deploybot: APPROVALS: release-lead rachel and eng punit. Lifting pin and starting canary. Will post updates every 2m.

deploybot: 02:15 UTC - canary 5% started.

deploybot: 02:23 UTC - telemetry: p95=195ms (baseline 180ms), errors 0.03%. within thresholds.

rachel: ok to ramp when ops gives final check.

ops-oncall: 02:27 UTC - metrics stable. approve ramp to 50%.

deploybot: ramping to 50% over 5m.

deploybot: 02:35 UTC - ramp complete. telemetry stable. commencing final ramp to 100%.

deploybot: 02:44 UTC - rollout complete, pin removed, audit saved: unpin-kv-1201, run-id 20261201-a9b.

emma: changelog updated, customers notified. unfreeze complete.

rachel: thanks team. follow-up: postmortem to capture why flag caused eviction storms. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
